map.BIC 代码验证器。输入 8 或 11 位银行识别码（SWIFT），校验长度与字: BIC code validator. Enter an 8- or 11-digit bank identifier code (SWIFT) to validate length and character format, for code-format checks in international remittance and inter-bank identification.
map.依据 ISO 9362 校验 BIC/SWIFT 代码：前 4 位银行码、2 位: Per ISO 9362 validate the BIC/SWIFT code: first 4 bank code, 2 country code, 2 location code are fixed length, with optional 3 branch code; format only.
map./SWIFT 代码为 8 位还是 11 位及字符结构: /SWIFT code is 8 or 11 digits and its character structure
map.跨境汇款前核对收款行 BIC 是否写错: Check whether the beneficiary bank BIC is miswritten before a cross-border remittance
map.解析机构码、国家码、位置码与分行码分段: Parse the institution, country, location and branch code segments
map.输入 DEUTDEFF 判为 8 位（银行码+国家码+位置码）；输入 DEUTD: Enter DEUTDEFF, judged as 8 digits (bank+country+location); enter DEUTDEFF500, judged as 11 digits (plus 3 branch code); the page parses each segment's meaning.
map.BIC 的 8 位和 11 位有什么区别？: What is the difference between 8-digit and 11-digit BIC?
map.前 8 位为银行码(4)+国家码(2)+位置码(2)，11 位在末尾追加 3 位: The first 8 are bank(4)+country(2)+location(2); 11 appends 3 branch code at the end; 8 alone defaults to the head office.
map.BIC 和 IBAN 是一回事吗？: Are BIC and IBAN the same thing?
map.不是。BIC 标识银行机构，IBAN 标识具体账户，跨境汇款通常两者都需要。: No. BIC identifies the bank; IBAN identifies the specific account; cross-border remittance usually needs both.
map.校验通过就能汇款吗？: Does passing validation guarantee the remittance works?
map.不能保证。页面只校验格式与结构，收款行是否可达、账户是否正确须由银行确认。: Not guaranteed. The page only checks format and structure; whether the beneficiary bank is reachable and the account correct must be confirmed by the bank.
